description: This is a false-colour infrared map illustrating land cover classification in an urban or peri-urban area. The imagery shows vegetation in various shades of red, bare soil or sparse vegetation in reddish-brown, artificial surfaces (buildings, roads) in grey/cyan tones, and a water body (likely a canal or river) in dark blue/black. The map features overlaid vector polygons: larger units are delimited by yellow lines, while smaller, more detailed units are outlined in light blue. Two prominent areas, appearing as reddish-brown plots of land, are labelled with the yellow text "1320". These "1320" areas represent "Land without current use," which, according to the document context, includes categories such as wasteland, former industrial areas ("brown fields"), gaps in new construction, or leftover land. Adjacent features include what appear to be industrial or infrastructure facilities (e.g., water treatment tanks) and various urban structures. No scale bar, compass, or explicit data source/year is visible.
